He will need a calm, adult-only home with experienced adopters who can continue helping him build confidence at his own pace. He also appreciates having a quiet space at mealtimes where he feels safe and secure. Criss Cross will need a home without cats as he is overly interested in them.

Criss Cross is a truly gorgeous, sweet-natured gentle giant with so much love to give. With patience, understanding, endless bum scratches and plenty of tasty treats, he has every chance to flourish into the loyal and devoted companion he is meant to be.

Criss Crosswill need more than one meet and greet with his prospective adopters to allow him time to build a bond and feel comfortable with them before being adopted.

Criss Cross is such a sweetheart! He is loyal to his friend Crumble, his kennel mums and dads. He’s still greeting everyone on walks with a bit of caution but once he’s recognised you, you’re considered family.

He’s going on occasional independent walks to gain his confidence but he is always looking for Crumble to keep him company. He’s very cautious of new things however day by day his confidence is growing and with his trust in his kennel mums he always runs back to check they’re okay, showing you just how brave he is and continues to be, so when the right home finds him….they will have to earn his trust and give him the patience and love he truly deserves.

This distinguished gent is progressing so well, every day!

He has started to get in the practice of being kennel clean, one of his kennel mums likes to come in a little early to help him practice this so when he finds his forever home it might be a little less stressful learning toilet training skills properly.

Criss Cross is even getting more adventurous greeting people on his daily walks now just to  say hello and maybe scoring a treat or fuss, and even recognising some of the staff when they visit him.

He is protective of Crumble and always looks to see her catching up on their daily walks, and enjoys playing with her or being near watching over her. But when he has his solo kennel time, he has been exploring his personal toy collection, anything with a treat in it and he’s happy. This cuddle bug deserves a home with endless bum scratches and scrumptious treats

This handsome guy is progressing every day! And showing his kennel mums just how much of a sweetheart he is. He is an affectionate goofball once he’s comfortable with you. He enjoys playing with his chow friend Crumble and he loves getting love from her and his kennel mums. He loves to jump up to have his harness put on, refusing to stand still because he gets so excited to go out and explore with Crumble.

Criss Cross will now even allow some of his part time kennel mums and dads to give him attention too. He is still very cautious of new people but is slowly meeting new people and remembering them!

With some time his new family will find out just how special Criss Cross is!

Criss Cross has made incredible progress over the last few days. He used to hide and grumble when people approached his kennel, but this has changed massively!

Now, Criss Cross comes up to the kennel door and wags his tail, getting very excited to see people. Spending time with this handsome boy brings me so much joy; I often find myself straying from my section just to sneak in five minutes of cuddles.

Criss Cross is still looking for a quiet, gentle home and someone who will take things slow while he gets to know them.

Criss-Cross has grown into an incredibly sociable and interactive boy, although he can still be a little shy when first meeting new people. Once he feels comfortable, he actively seeks out attention and loves a cuddle, often trying to give kisses in return. Criss-Cross is a big lad and is still learning his manners; when he’s excited he can occasionally use his size to try and barge past, but he responds well to clear, firm verbal guidance.

He will need a quiet area to enjoy his meals, as this helps him feel more secure. Criss-Cross is doing very well with his harness training and has already ventured out of the rescue for walks, managing a good distance down the road. He can still feel a little unsure if people are walking behind him, and one of his endearing little quirks is that he finds reassurance if you turn and face him while walking backwards. Criss-Cross is a truly gorgeous, sweet and gentle giant who will thrive in an active, patient and understanding home.

Criss Cross is a very worried soul who has come to us from a breeder, and is needing extra patience, understanding, and tender care. He appears to have had very little formal handling in his past and can be grumbly or anxious when he feels uncomfortable. He requires slow, careful introductions and time to begin to understand the world around him.

Criss Cross would thrive in an adult-only home with experienced owners who can provide the reassurance and consistency he needs to start building trust. He is still learning the basics of house training and walking on a lead, so his adopters will need to be patient and gentle as he gradually discovers confidence. He will need an understanding and kind resident dog in the home he can look to as he continues to learn and trust.

This sweet, sensitive boy is not yet ready for the full bustle of the world, but with time, quiet encouragement, and safe garden sniffing adventures, he will slowly open up and reveal the loyal companion he can be. Criss Cross will need a calm, loving home where his cautious nature is respected and nurtured and where he can finally feel safe and truly belong.

These wonderful souls may be older, have medical needs, or come with a few unique quirks—but they have endless love to give. Full of personality and deserving of a second chance, they come with a reduced adoption fee to help them find the perfect home. Could you be the one to give them the love they’ve been waiting for?

name: Lizzie
description:
Lizzie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four to five years old.

Lizzie came into our care around a year ago after we met her on a trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She was scarily emaciated back then and we did wonder if she would survive long enough for us to get her to the UK. She did make it onto the bus and arrived safely in her uk foster home.

Lizzie was always curious about people and happy to be around them but was initially afraid to be actually touched but is now a very affectionate and loving girl with huge enthusiasm for human contact.

Lizzie enjoys the company of other dogs and would prefer another, full time resident, dog in her forever home. She would be ok as an only dog if someone was home most of the time and she had plenty of interaction with other dogs out on walks.

Lizzie is a playful and cheery girl who enjoys her walks. She can be wary of tall men in the home until she gets to know them well. Lizzie is fine with the safe rescue cat and can live with children aged twelve plus.

name: Whiskey
description:
Whiskey is a medium sized crossbreed aged three to four years old.

We met Whiskey about eighteen months ago when we found him in an emaciated state in the Botosani public shelter. We immediately moved him to a private shelter where he would be able to eat properly and gain weight.

Eventually we were able to take him in the UK

On arrival Whiskey was very distrustful of us, but he now loves us so much he can barely contain it all . Whiskey is very playful and will need another dog in his forever home as full time resident.

He’s still wary of strangers but when he loves you he is the most loyal and affectionate boy. Whiskey walks nicely on a lead but is still a bit wary of having the lead put on and taken off, we will continue to help him grow more confident with this whilst he’s in our care.

Whiskey will need someone experienced with nervous dogs as gaining his trust initially wil take time. Once the bond is made though he is truly a dog in a million.

name: Elena
description:
Elena is a five to six year old female Cross-Breed who is medium to large in size and currently fostered in Marlborough, Wiltshire.

She can live with or without other dogs, can live with children of all ages, and has not yet been cat tested, though she may be suitable.

We met Elena in March this year when we visited the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. She had a badly twisted front leg. She had two operations to try and fix the damaged limb, but sadly they didn’t work and it was ultimately amputated.

Elena is the most joyous dog you could ever meet. Despite her surroundings in the grim shelter she remains bubbly and upbeat.

She is friendly and affectionate and loves everyone she meets. Elena mixes well with other dogs but could also live happily as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children of all ages.

name: Cessil
description:
Cessil is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old. Cessil fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Cessil has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter where he has been imprisoned for at least the last couple of years.

Cessil is an affectionate and fun dog once you get to know him but is initially hand shy with strangers. Cessil loves the company of other dogs and will need at least one other dog as permanent resident in his forever home.

Cessil has initially been quite resistant to lead training but is now getting the hang of it and will just need to build up confidence with practise in his forever home. He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Sara
description:
Sara is a medium sized crossbreed born December 2021.

Sara has came into our care from Romania at a year old as her carer there was moving to the UK and she was worried for her future.

Sara is a placid and sensitive girl who can be a little cautious of new people. She quickly warms up to family though and is an affectionate and friendly girl.

Sara mixes well with other dogs but could also live as an only dog. She would need an adult family as she can be anxious around playful behaviour.

Sara needs a calm and quiet home environment as she can be very anxious around visitors to the home. She is such a loving and sweet girl to her family but has spent three years in our care now with no offers of a home.

name: Hilda
description:
Hilda is a large Romanian shepherd cross. Her passport says she was born Feb 2019 but she acts a bit older than six.

We have been a part of Hilda’s life and her a part of ours for years. She was in the private shelter in Crivatu Romania the very first time we visited and stayed there until 2024.

The story of how she came to be rescued, if indeed it’s true, is too horrible to put into print so I will just say that she has been through a lot and, although understandably scared of people, treats us with nothing but gentleness.

Hilda is a large dog with a calm presence. She moves with grace and poise and is quite regal in her demeanour.

She will avoid strangers if she can but once she is used to the people in the home she will choose to be close by and always looks like she wants to come for a fuss but she’s just not quite ready yet.

When you go to her she is happy to be fussed and groomed and will fall asleep with her head on your lap.

Hilda is not keen on her walks and really doesn’t want to go for more than fifteen minutes. We are not sure if this is a crisis of confidence or if it’s a mobility issue, she’s a difficult dog to read.

She walks nicely on a lead but can panic when spooked so we are looking for a rural home for her as she will not cope with a lot of traffic or crowds.

Despite her fears Hilda is such a gentle dog, she will need a calm and quiet environment with no children under twelve and with at least one other dog.

Anyone considering adopting her must be calm and patient in gaining her trust and maybe she will never fully open up to humans due to the horrors of her past. She is fine with the safe rescue cat, but won’t look at him.

name: Peter
description:
Peter is a large crossbreed aged around fifteen months old. Peter fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Peter and his siblings were found in a city in Romania last January. Small pups, lost and wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Peter has been on our care since last July. For most of that time he was very neurotic and skittish but recently we’ve all noticed an element of him maturing and becoming a lot more confident.

He still spooks at some things but the spooky reaction is not so melodramatic and passes quickly.

Peter is a sweet boy once he knows you, he’s not ready for strangers being hands on with him but he gets used to new people so much faster now and we’re still working daily on improving his confidence.

Peter will still need an experienced adopter with the time and patience to continue with his confidence building. He will need a calm and steady household with no children.

He will need a confident dog in his forever home that will play with him as he loves the rough and tumble of his foster pack.

name: Romeo
description:
Romeo is a chunky medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Romeo fostered Norwich Norfolk.

He has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania.

We’ve known this boy for over two years now and walked him on several trips to the shelter. He’s always been so happy to see us and a really nice boy to take out. He’s very friendly and confident.

Romeo could live very happily with a female dog or dogs but would also enjoy being the only dog in the home. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Finn
description:
Finn is a five to six month old crossbreed pup who we believe will grow to be medium sized. Finn fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Finn has come into our care recently from the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. He is initially quite hand shy with new people but his confidence is growning daily.

He is much braver when he has an adult dog to shadow around and we would therefore need to find him a home with at least one other dog in permanent residence.

He is mixing well with the safe rescue cat and will need a home with children no younger than twelve.

He will need all the usual training and care that all pups need and adopters should expect peeing, poohing, chewing and potentially sleepless nights until work is put into training them out of it.

name: Ralph
description:
Ralph is a medium sized golden Labrador cross aged around eight years old. Ralph fostered Taverham Norfolk.

We believe this boy to be Rupert’s son and he’s an absolute chip off the old block with both looks and stubborn mannerisms.

Poor Ralph spent years in the Botosani public shelter in Romania, his two brothers are still there and can’t come to us until we’ve found homes for the two such similar souls that we have already!

Ralph is a sweet old soul that is learning all about his new domestic life, but he’s insistent on putting up a little bit of protest regarding “new tricks” such as walking on a lead.

He’ll do it, and he’ll enjoy the walk, but he’s just gotta tell you first that he doesn’t appreciate being restricted to going where the humans want him to go. If he wants to sniff something, he’s going to let you know, he’s just actually very amusing!

He asks for a fuss but then looks confused about why he’s asked and why he’s enjoying it, but you can see that he is . It’s a lot to get used to and he’s just through the process in his own unique way and we’re loving watching it happen.

Ralph gets on with other dogs to a point but would rather be the only dog in the home. Despite never having a bed or bedding in his life before, he’s decided he likes them and he doesn’t want to share them.

It’s all bluster and bravado but perhaps it would be easier just to let him have his own way in this one and let him be the only dog in the home, he does deserve to be spoilt after all! He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

Despite all the comedy antics, Ralph is so happy to be here and be around the humans who he seems to understand are just trying to love him and be his friend. His tail is wagging a lot these days and he just needs his own forever home to wag it in!

name: Neddy
description:
Neddy is a medium sized crossbreed aged around ten months old. Neddy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Neddy was part of a litter that were found abandoned somewhere in Corbeanca, Romania, in a field. No mum with them. A lady contacted rescuers and begged for help… Bianca took them to her shelter.

The only girl left for Belgium, the daughter of the lady who found them adopted her. One boy left for Germany.

Dave arrived a couple of months ago and was successfully adopted and now Neddy has arrived along with the other two remaining siblings to find their happy ever afters.

Neddy is a very sweet and playful boy who is loving the adventure of the change to a UK foster home. He’s having great fun playing with other dogs and humans alike.

He’s having could live with other dogs or as an only dog. Loves his toys and fuss and walks nicely on a lead. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Tara
description:
Tara is a small to medium sized female crossbred aged around twelve years old. Fostered in Rollesby Norfolk.

Tara originally came into our care several years ago. She was rehomed along with two other of our dogs but they have sadly all had to come back to us recently as their adopters unexpected health issues means she can no longer care for them.

Tara has lived with cats and dogs but could happily be the only dog in the home. She loves her walks and is in good health for her age. She will need an adult family and can be wary of some men.

name: Hovis
description:
Hovis is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old.

We met Hovis on the last day of our trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania in March 2024. He so nearly missed being seen amongst the 800 prisoners there until at that eleventh hour his enquisitive and cheeky face appeared in the pen next door.

He was in with some very old and grumpy dogs and had been for some time. He finally boarded the van to the UK last September and has been awaiting his forever home.

Hovis is a sweet and affectionate boy who will play for hours with his canine friends in his foster home. He absolutely loves his walks but does pull a little on the lead so will need further training, he has a fabulous time when we take him to a secure field.

He loves to play with toys and would like another playful dog in his forever home if possible.

Hovis would like an adult home environment and is perfectly fine with cats.

name: Princess
description:
Princess is a medium sized Chow cross aged around five years old. Princess fostered Hockley Essex.

Princess has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. Life wasn’t so very terrible for her in the first few months of her stay at Botosani.

Her and her brother were in a pen on their own and they had each other to snuggle up to and play with. A few weeks ago we were gutted to learn that her brother left the shelter and she remained behind.

We’ve been conspiring to get her from the very second we knew he left as we were eaten up by how miserable she would be and how she simply wouldn’t understand why he suddenly vanished.

Our hearts literally ached for her. We’ve had set backs along the way and it’s taken far longer than we wanted but, finally, she is in a UK foster home and she’s having a ball.

Princess is an incredibly friendly and cheerful girl who settled instantly in her foster home and quickly behaved like she’d never lived anywhere else!

She gets on well with her foster siblings but could also live happily as the only dog in her forever home. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

name: Britney
description:
Britney is a medium, sized, lab-type crossbreed of around 3-4 years old.

Britney is fostered in Marlborough Wiltshire.

We met Britney and her mum and sister when we visited the Botosani public shelter in Romania at the beginning of October last year.

All three travelled to the UK to start a new life away from the horrors of the shelter, and both mum and sister are now happily living in their forever homes.

Britney is a friendly and affectionate girl who is submissive and hand-shy at first, but once she is settled she is extremely sweet and loves a fuss and a cuddle.

Britney will need a resident dog(s) in her new home. She would also be ok with confident cats and respectful children aged eight and over.

name: Shannon
description:
Shannon is a medium sized collie type crossbreed aged around two years old. Shannon fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Shannon has come into our care recently due to her owner no longer being able to adequately care for her.

Shannon is a fun loving girl with a lot of energy and will need a fairly active home where she can be sufficiently exercised. She mixes well with other dogs but could live happily as the only dog in the home.

She is fine with cats and would need an adult only home.

Shannon is strong on a lead initially on walks but does relax a few minutes into them.

name: Havannah
description:
Havannah is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Havannah fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Havannah came into our care recently as her owner could no longer look after her. After an initial few days of shyness she evolves into a sweet and loving girl who enjoys a fuss and will happily curl up with you on the sofa.

Havannah has lived with dogs and cats but could also be the only dog in her forever home . She walks nicely on a lead and is a calm and quiet addition to the family.

She can live with respectful children 12 plus.

name: Pete
description:
Pete is a large crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Pete is fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Pete and his siblings were found in a city in Romania in January 2025. Small pups, lost, wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Pete is a typical adolescent dog, clumsily learning the canine lessons of life. He is initially shy with new people and takes time to bond. He is not an overly affectionate dog but will always be close by.

Pete would love to live with another playful dog but could go as the only dog. Pete could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He will need an adopter experienced with large breeds who has the time and patience to win his trust.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around eight to ten years old.Eric fostered Norwich Norfolk.

We originally met Eric a couple of years ago in the Botosani public shelter in Romania. After we left he was attacked at the throat by the other dogs in his pen so we asked for a space at Crivatu private shelter to move him to.

He has had a lovely time in the safety of that sanctuary for the past couple of years but it’s now his turn to get into a proper home for his twilight years.

Eric can be a quirky little chap until you get to know him but he is a dear little soul with a permanently smiling face that you cannot help but grow to love.

Eric is enjoying short walks but will need to lose some weight and build fitness gradually to enjoy a level of walking that should come more easily to him. He gets on well with other dogs and is very good with cats.

He needs an adult home environment. It’s taken a while for this little dude to come waddling to the UK and we’re hopeful that he will find his forever person or persons so that he can continue to enjoy the comforts of domestic life.

name: Dwayne
description:
Dwayne is a large mountain shepherd mix aged around seven years old. Dwayne the rock fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Dwayne has come into our care recently as his owner was no longer able to meet his needs. He is a lovely boy who needs the company of another dog in his forever home.

He’s not selective on who that dog maybe as he appears to be pleasant and sociable with all of them!

Dwayne has the dopiest grin and is a sweet and affectionate boy. We would like a home with large breed experience for him who will not be put off by his booming big boy bark .

Dwayne hasn’t been around children so will need an adult home environment.

name: Peach
description:
Peach is a medium to large sized crossbreed aged around six to seven years old.Peach fostered Taverham Norfolk.

Peach has come into our care recently due to a change in domestic circumstances in her previous home. She is a sweet and mild mannered girl who would really love to have a quiet life in a serene environment.

She gets on ok with cats, dogs, goats, rabbits and a parrot! She would also be very content to be the only dog in the home.

Peach enjoys her walks but is a little out of shape currently and her fitness level therefore needs to be increased gradually. She is happiest snuggled up in bed with her humans close at hand! She could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Kori
description:
Kori is a medium to large sized crossbreed aged around five years old. Kori fostered Badersfield Norfolk.

Kori has come into our care recently after his adopters circumstances changed and they could no longer adequately care for a dog.

Kori is a beautiful sweet natured boy. He is friendly and playful with other dogs but could also live as the only dog in the home. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus and has been fine with introductions to the safe rescue cat.

name: Badger
description:
Badger is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old. Badger fostered Badersfield Norfolk.

Badger originally into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. He arrived a couple of months ago and was swiftly adopted but has sadly been reluctantly returned due to his energy levels not matching the home environment.

Badger is a brilliant character who gets on with everyone and everything. He is friendly and affectionate and a busy boy who wants to be involved in all the family goings on.

He will need a decent level of exercise in his forever home and some basic training to channel his enthusiasm for jumping up. He can live with or without other dogs and is fine with cats. He could live with respectful children of ten plus.

name: Alfie
description:
Alfie is a German shepherd cross aged around four years old. Alfie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Alfie and his siblings were found as puppies in a wood yard in Romania adjacent to a very busy highway. The three pups were rescued and taken to a safe shelter where they grew up safely.

Alfie’s two sisters, Alice and Alba, were adopted along the way but Alfie has spent four years waiting for his chance to come to the UK to find a home.

Alfie is a biggish chap who would suit an experienced shepherd owner. He is mixing well with dogs in his foster home but maybe best as an only dog or with just one steady female.

He has met the very robust safe rescue cat and ignored him. Alfie has little experience with children and we would be looking for a home with no children under the age of twelve.

Alfie loves his walks and walks nicely on a lead.

name: Scribble
description:
Scribble is a largeish crossbreed aged around three years old. He has come into our care recently due to his owner not being able to care for him. Scribble fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Scribble is a great dog, very gentle despite his size and extremely placid. Due to lacking socialisation in his previous home he is playing a bit of catch up out in the big wide world but he is learning fast and has the makings of a wonderful family member.

Scribble would like the company of another dog in his forever home, he’s also extremely well behaved around cats, rabbits and goats!

He could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He would be shy initially but with a little time and understanding would soon be a loving addition to the family.

name: Letty
description:
Letty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Letty fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Letty has come into our care recently due to a change in domestic circumstances. She is a quiet and sweet girl who is initially timid with new people.

She will need a confident dog to buddy up to in her forever home and when she sees them relaxed and approaching people for fuss she will then follow suit. She would therefore not be happy as the only dog in the home.

Letty would like a quiet and calm home with no children under the age of twelve. She walks nicely on a lead and has met amicably with the safe rescue cat.

name: Charlie
description:
Charlie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Charlie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Charlie has come into our care recently in a bit of a sorry state and has unfortunately had to undergo a close shave haircut as none of his coat was salvageable.

Charlie gets on great with other dogs and cats but could also be only dog in his forever home. He enjoys his walks and is well behaved out and about. He would like a quietish environment in an adult only home.

name: Lotty
description:
Lotty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old.

The team met Lotty on their trip to Roxanas shelter back in June. She was a late addition to the transport list after they noticed that she was getting severely picked on by her pen mates every time the dogs all barked.

It was decided she really needed to be free from the bullies and so she was swiftly added.

Lotty is a timid girl initially who is not brave in new situations. She is learning to accept new things all the time and becoming braver but will still need to gain life experience in her forever home.

Once comfortable she is cheeky and affectionate and great fun. Lotty will need an adult family with one other dog in the household as full time resident. She has been fine with the safe rescue cat but may chase a more nervy cat when she found her feet.

name: Molly
description:
Molly is an approximately 2 year old female Cross-Breed of medium size, currently in Blackpool and looking for either a foster placement or a permanent home.

Molly originally travelled to the UK and spent time in a foster home where she settled well and learned the basics of home life.

She lived with another dog, children, cats, and small animals, and was affectionate and well bonded with her family during this time.

When she later moved into an adoptive home, Molly struggled with the change in environment and the lack of consistent structure.

She became increasingly unsettled within the home, including behaviours such as patrolling and guarding areas of the house.

On walks, she also began to show the early development of reactivity. As the family felt unable to continue supporting her through these challenges, Molly was returned to the rescue and moved into kennels.

Since arriving in kennels, Molly has settled well and has shown a much more stable and relaxed temperament. She is friendly with everyone she meets and has shown no reactivity or redirected behaviours in the kennel environment.

She is a firm favourite with staff and is described as affectionate, sociable, and easy to handle.

It is expected that Molly will need a structured, consistent home environment going forward, with continued training, clear boundaries, and patient guidance to help her feel secure and supported. With this in place, she has the potential to thrive.

Molly is an affectionate and loving young dog who enjoys human company and forms strong bonds once settled.

She may need time to build confidence with new people due to her previous experiences, but she is willing to engage and responds well to calm handling.

She is an active dog who will require regular exercise and mental stimulation. She has good recall and walks nicely on the lead when settled.

Molly could potentially live with other dogs and has previously lived with cats and small animals, with appropriate introductions. A secure garden and a stable, predictable home environment will be important for her.

Molly is now ready for a committed home that can offer her structure, patience, and ongoing support so she can move forward confidently and safely.

When contacting us, please include a phone number or a non-iCloud email address, as iCloud emails are currently bouncing and we cannot contact applicants using them.

All dogs rehomed via this rescue will be vaccinated, neutered/spayed, and microchipped. Home checks apply, and full post-adoption support is offered.

name: Goldie
description:
Goldie is a 5 year old female Cross-Breed weighing approximately 48kg and is looking for her forever home from Blackpool, UK.

Goldie spent most of her life in a multi-dog household where she was settled and familiar with her routine.

When her family’s circumstances changed significantly, including long working hours and health issues, they were no longer able to meet her needs. Her world changed quickly, and she began a difficult period of instability.

She moved through a couple of foster homes but found the changes and time alone overwhelming and struggled to settle. Because of this, she eventually moved into kennels, where she has now been for several months.

Kennel life has taken time for her to adjust to, but she is gradually learning to feel safe again. With people she knows and trusts, her personality shines through.

She forms strong bonds, seeks affection, and shows a deeply loyal and loving nature once she feels secure.

She enjoys the company of familiar kennel staff and, in those moments of trust, she becomes playful, affectionate, and eager for closeness and reassurance.

She walks well on the lead and enjoys her walks once she has built a bond with her handler.

She can be wary of unfamiliar people and needs time to build trust at her own pace.

She also shows guarding instincts around her home and people, particularly when meeting new individuals, so she will need an experienced, understanding home that can manage this calmly and safely.

Because of this, Goldie is looking for an adult-only home with a quiet, predictable environment and limited visitors, ideally in a rural or low-traffic setting.

She could potentially live with calm, friendly dogs following careful introductions, as they may help support her confidence.

Goldie is not suited to a busy household, but in the right stable and experienced home, she has every chance to build a strong, trusting bond and thrive.

Meets and greets can be arranged following a successful home check.

When contacting us, please include a phone number or a non-iCloud email address, as iCloud emails are currently bouncing and we cannot contact applicants using them.

All dogs rehomed via this rescue will be vaccinated, neutered/spayed, and microchipped. Home checks apply, and full post-adoption support is offered.

name: Camila
description:
Camila is an approximately 5 year old female Cross-Breed of medium size, currently in kennels in Macedonia and hoping to find a home in the UK.

Camila is an affectionate, friendly, and social little dog with a very easy-going and loving temperament. She enjoys human company and forms bonds quickly, often seeking closeness and affection from people she meets.

She gets along very well with other dogs and is happy in their company. She has also been assessed as being comfortable around cats. Camila is suitable to live with children and is generally a playful and sociable girl.

Despite spending time in kennel conditions, Camila is still a cheerful girl, always happy to greet people warmly. She shows a bright, affectionate personality even in a stressful environment.

Camila is the type of dog who enjoys companionship and will likely thrive in a home where she can be included in daily life. She enjoys being near her people and would suit a home where she can be part of the family routine.

Camila has tested positive for leishmania but is not displaying any symptoms. Dogs with leishmania can often live long, happy lives, and the condition can usually be managed with appropriate treatment and monitoring.

She is ready to travel to the UK for adoption with full rescue support.

When contacting us, please include a phone number or a non-iCloud email address, as iCloud emails are currently bouncing and we cannot contact applicants using them.

All dogs rehomed via this rescue will be vaccinated, neutered/spayed, and microchipped. Home checks apply, and full post-adoption support is offered.

name: Dora
description:
Dora is a 3 year old female Labrador Cross. She is looking for a forever home. She is neutered, chipped, and vaccinated. She is now moved to kennels in Preesall.

Dora is a wonderful dog and has brought her owners lots of happiness. She is incredibly clever, learns commands very quickly and loves to play!

Dora is such a playful and happy girl and has her owners laughing every day with her cheeky personality.

Dora travels well in the car and is happy just sleeping when she is left at home alone. She shows can be reactive to humans when out on walks, although has made lots of progress with this recently and is becoming much more relaxed around new people and dogs.

Visitors can be managed once she knows people well, and she does form close bonds with others outside of her family who she adores!

Dora cannot be homed with young children due to her reactivity and general bounciness. She is also very fearful of cats.

Dora can sometimes guard food and spaces but again has shown much improvement with this over recent months.

Dora has excellent recall and always wants to be near her humans. She loves being outside, playing fetch and running about.

Dora’s an absolute joy, and anyone would be very lucky to have her. We are looking for a home with experienced dog owners who can manage fear reactivity and continue on her positive journey with this.

Dora likes to say hello to other dogs but would be happier being the only dog in the house. We would also prefer a calmer household in a rural/semi-rural environment for her.

name: Bodie
description:
Bodie is a 2 year old male Labrador Cross currently located in Leicestershire, UK. He is urgently seeking a very special and experienced home after being unable to settle in his current environment.

Bodie is a Labrador-sized dog, weighing approximately 27kg, with a long body and legs.

Bodie had a lively start in a Macedonian rescue, playing freely with his siblings, but he has struggled to adapt to life in his current home, particularly around children and other pets.

He is a nervous boy, which can lead to reactivity toward other dogs on walks, although he improves when on a longer lead. Bodie is also nervous around visitors to the house, sometimes snapping when he feels threatened.

He is being rehomed because his adopters found him too strong and because he is not cat-friendly. Bodie would do best in a semi-rural home with a physically fit adopter who has experience working with large reactive dogs.

He should not be rehomed with cats or children but may benefit from living with a confident resident dog.

name: Hazel
description:
Meet Hazel, a 3 year old female Shepherd Cross who is ready for her forever home.

Hazel has made significant progress in her behaviour thanks to a dedicated foster home, but she still requires a calm, adult-only environment to continue her journey.

Hazel is a playful dog who loves her toys and enjoys cuddles. While she takes time to warm up to new people, she is loyal and intelligent, eager to show off her tricks.

As a large, active dog, she needs around two hours of exercise each day and would thrive with a confident resident dog.

The ideal home for Hazel is one with experienced owners who can provide the ongoing training she needs. A secure garden and access to quiet walking areas are essential, as she may feel anxious in busy environments.

Additionally, her new family should be prepared to help her adjust to new surroundings, as she can be nervous at first.

Hazel is spayed, microchipped, and vaccinated, with lifelong rescue backup and support available.

If you can offer her the understanding and love she deserves, please consider giving her the forever home she’s been waiting for.

To apply for adoption, please complete the form on our website: https://strayswithoutborders.org.uk/adoption-process/.When contacting us, please include a phone number or a non-iCloud email address, as iCloud emails are currently bouncing and we cannot contact applicants using them.

name: Willow
description:
She only has a few weeks to find a home, and we are a bit desperate. Thank you.

Willow is a sweet and affectionate 6 year old female Cross-Breed dog who thrives in a calm and quiet environment. She prefers a peaceful home with minimal visitors and enjoys a steady routine.

While she can be vocal with new people, she settles well with those she trusts. If unfamiliar guests move too quickly, she may nip at their legs, so a patient and understanding adopter is ideal.

When out on walks, Willow dislikes heavy traffic and crowded areas but does well in open spaces where she can see an exit. She’s indifferent to other dogs but does not appreciate overly excitable or bouncy ones.

At home, she is a loving companion who enjoys her early bedtime at 7:30 PM and sleeps soundly through the night. She is house-trained with very few accidents, knows basic commands like “sit” and “wait,” and has a decent recall. She has become more food-motivated, which helps with training, and she absolutely loves her outdoor walks!

Willow was diagnosed with a thyroid condition about 18 months ago, for which she requires medication (we have a 2-3 months’ supply). She has also been on calming pills due to recent home renovations but is expected to manage fine without them now that things have settled.

Recently, she surprised us by doing exceptionally well in kennels, despite initial concerns. The staff adored her, which was a big win!

name: Luna
description:
Meet Luna, a 5-year-old female Border Collie who was adopted in the UK but was later returned due to anxiety and reactivity issues.

After spending time in rehabilitation, she now thrives at Sakima’s Sanctuary in Blackpool, where she has made remarkable progress.

Smart, healthy, and eager to learn, Luna loves agility, obedience training, and long walks.

She needs a calm, understanding adopter who can respect her space, manage her reactivity, and continue her training.

Though affectionate on her terms, she’s not a cuddle bug and prefers gentle, minimal attention.

Luna has made great strides with other dogs and now enjoys quiet walks and car rides with her trusted people.

Her ideal home is a quiet, adult-only environment, ideally as an only dog, with adopters who enjoy rural walks and mental exercises.

Luna is spayed, vaccinated, and microchipped, ready for her forever home.

name: Toby
description:
Toby is a 4 year old Cross-Breed boy with the look of a white teddy bear and a loving heart. Toby adores women and children, though he can be cautious with men until he learns to trust.

Life hasn’t always been easy, and busy places, traffic, and car journeys can overwhelm him. But with training and patience, he’s making real progress and enjoying calm local walks.

He can be scared of people and dogs he doesn’t know, but with gentle introduction, he can come over his fears.

At home, Toby is affectionate, loves back scratches, can be left for short periods, and relaxes well. He would thrive in a quiet, patient home—ideally countryside—with older children and the companionship of a friendly female dog.

Toby is still young, playful, and full of love, waiting for someone to help him blossom into the wonderful companion he’s meant to be.

We are looking for an experienced family, who won’t mind taking it slow with him, and continuing to work on his progress.

He would love nothing more than to chill in a calm environment and have a confident canine and human friends to help him feel more secure and to play with him.

name: Freya
description:
Meet Freya, a 3 year old female Kokoni Cross who is looking for a calm and loving home.

She was rescued as a puppy from the streets of Macedonia and is now seeking a new home due to her family experiencing a very difficult period following a serious illness, meaning they can no longer provide the stable environment she needs.

Freya is a sensitive and intelligent dog with a big personality. She is quirky, funny and very loyal once she learns to trust someone, becoming a sweet and affectionate companion who loves being close to her people.

She enjoys playing and short bursts of running, and her charming circus paws are guaranteed to make you smile.

Due to anxiety and her difficult early life, Freya needs an experienced and patient adopter who can provide calm guidance and consistency.

She can be reactive towards unfamiliar people and some dogs, and would do best in a quieter home without cats, where her confidence can continue to grow at her own pace.

Freya manages well with a mild hip condition and lives a happy, active life with sensible exercise.

She is looking for a committed home that understands sensitive dogs and is willing to give her the time and space she needs to truly flourish.

If you feel you could offer Freya the safe and loving home she deserves, please apply using the organisation’s adoption process.

When contacting them, please include a phone number or a non-icloud email address, as icloud emails are currently bouncing and they cannot contact applicants using them.

name: Leah
description:
Leah is a two year old female Terrier Cross who is affectionate, intelligent, and full of curiosity.

Leah didn’t have an easy start in life. As a puppy, she was kept on a balcony by an addict and only survived because kind neighbours managed to throw her food. Soon after, she was abandoned on the streets and quickly became pregnant.

Thankfully, caring neighbours stepped in and had her spayed immediately, but Leah was still struggling to cope. She would follow children around the playground, hoping someone might take her home… but no one ever did.

After a short stay in a public shelter, we took her into kennels and soon afterwards she was adopted by a lovely family. Unfortunately, we have now received the sad news that Leah needs to be rehomed as the family’s other dog is not coping with her and the current dynamics are no longer suitable.

Leah missed out on vital love and care in her early years and had to learn how to survive on the streets. Adjusting to life in a home was a big challenge, but she has come a long way. She has learned how to settle, share, play nicely and how to manage her excitement.

Leah is a funny, affectionate girl full of curiosity and intelligence. She loves mental stimulation, training games and one-to-one attention. She already knows many commands and is patient around food, waiting for instruction before eating or going through a doorway.

Walks are still very exciting for her and she can become overwhelmed in certain environments, especially around other dogs. She does have a few specific triggers that can make her reactive, but with continued support, structure and patience she has already made amazing progress and will continue to do so.

She will thrive in a calm, consistent environment where she feels safe and secure – ideally with one person or a couple who enjoy an active lifestyle and are committed to continuing her training.

Leah adores cuddles and loves to snuggle under a blanket (and occasionally dry herself off in the bedsheets!). She is an energetic, loving girl who is ready for a forever home where she can continue to grow into the best version of herself.

Leah is spayed, vaccinated, healthy and comes with full Rescue Back Up.

To apply for adoption, please complete the form on our website: https://strayswithoutborders.org.uk/adoption-process/.When contacting us, please include a phone number or a non-iCloud email address, as iCloud emails are currently bouncing and we cannot contact applicants using them.

name: Coco
description:
Coco is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed weighing 10.6kg. She is currently located in Swindon and is looking for a calm, understanding home.

Coco is an absolute sweetheart with so much love to give. She adores her people and is happiest when she’s close to them, enjoying cuddles, affection, and simply being part of family life.

She loves spending time in the garden soaking up the sunshine, enjoys her walks, and has a gentle, loving nature with those she knows and trusts.

Coco shares her home with a confident Golden Retriever, and she loves him, though her love is not always returned as he is more of an independent dog.

She takes a lot of comfort from having another dog around, so we’re looking for a home with a confident, playful resident dog who can continue to help her feel secure.

She can be left for a few hours with another dog for company but finds being completely alone much harder.

As Coco has got older, she has become more worried by strangers coming into the home and finds a busy household difficult to cope with.

With the children in her current home now growing up and friends visiting more often, it has become clear that this environment is no longer the right fit for her.

She would thrive in a calm, adult-only home with a predictable routine and few visitors, where she can feel safe and relaxed.

Out on walks, Coco can be a little unsure of unfamiliar people and dogs when on the lead, but she enjoys exploring quieter areas and has good recall in secure spaces.

Coco is looking for kind, patient adopters who will appreciate what a loving companion she is. In the right home, with another friendly dog by her side and plenty of affection from her humans, she will make a wonderfully loyal and devoted best friend.

name: Sky
description:
Sky is a medium English Setter, 5 years old.

Sky’s story, as with so many of our dogs, didn’t begin in the easiest way. Rescued from a hunter in Spain, she arrived at the shelter frightened, overwhelmed and unsure whether people could be trusted.

After spending some time there, one of our wonderful foster homes in Essex offered to foster her in November 2025 and that’s when her new life truly began.

While she is still naturally shy and a little sensitive, every month has brought new milestones. Watching her confidence blossom has been incredibly rewarding, and she’s now ready to find the forever home that will help her continue her journey.

Sky shares her foster home with several resident dogs, and they have been her greatest teachers. She absolutely thrives in their company and has learned that life can be fun.

One of her favourite games is playing tag with the resident English Setter – where she has gone from always being the one chased to proudly becoming the chaser herself! It’s a lovely reminder of just how far she has come.

Although Sky remains nervous around new people and unfamiliar situations, once she feels safe her affectionate nature shines through.

She loves gentle fuss and will often quietly inch closer for a cuddle. When she’s completely relaxed, she’ll happily flop onto her back, inviting you to rub her tummy, a privilege reserved for those who have earned her trust.

Like many sensitive dogs, Sky appreciates having the choice to retreat to her own safe space when she needs a little quiet time.

Giving her the freedom to move at her own pace has been key to her progress, and her future family will need to continue offering her that patience and understanding.

Sky is looking for a calm, quiet and kind home with people who won’t expect too much too soon. A confident, friendly resident dog is essential, as they will give her reassurance and confidence.

She is a truly beautiful girl, inside and out, and while she may never be the dog who greets strangers with instant enthusiasm, she will form an incredibly special bond with the people lucky enough to earn her trust.

Sky will celebrate her sixth birthday this September, and nothing would make us happier than seeing her spend it in the forever home she has waited so patiently to find.

name: Mora
description:
Mora is a medium English Setter, 7 years old.

Mora is one of four setters who was given up by their hunter when he became unwell and was no longer able to look after them.

She is a very energetic, confident and happy girl.

She lives with four other setters and they all get on really well together, sharing their kennel and all eating together.

Mora is very playful and is always happy play with the other dogs.

She is very affectionate and always eager for a fuss and a cuddle.

She comes running when she’s called around the shelter, although this will no doubt be different on an exciting walk!

She can live with older children and can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Simba
description:
Simba is a medium mixed breed, 8 years old.

Simba turned up in a village on his own, nobody knew where he was come from but the rescue that took him in say he was in such a state he ‘must have lived through hell’.

He arrived very skinny but is putting on weight but sadly had to have half his tail amputated due to a bad infection.

Despite whatever his past may hold, Simba is learning to enjoy life again, rolling in the grass and living with other dogs.

He gets on well with all the male and female dogs he lives with and he’s also passed his cat test, meaning he could live in a home with a resident cat as well.

name: Charlie
description:
Charlie is a 6 years old male cross breed located in Ipswich.

This handsome lad is Charlie, he has a glossy, black short, soft coat and he is a medium sized boy standing at only 20 inches from shoulder to paw.

Charlie is castrated and he is outgoing and loves to play. He loves cuddles and praise. Charlie is 2 years

Charlie is coming out of a home and is well trained, used to children and other dogs plus he has been with cats. He is only being rehomed for owners health reasons.

He loves toys and is playful, clean in the house, good on harness….

He needs to live with another dog preferably a quiet rural environment and needs an experienced home. He can live with children over 6 years.

name: Lucia
description:
Lucia is a 10 month old cross breed fostered in Derbyshire .

Lucia is an very pretty, medium-sized puppy girl Cross breed, with a fluffy off white soft coat She is a lovely gentle girl, and at times quite nervous but very affectionate and loves attention from the volunteers and enjoys being cuddled and groomed.

She gets on well with her kennel mate, but definitely prefers to be with people.

Lucia has just started her lead training which is going well, as we don’t think she is used to being walked because she came with chain round her neck and black stains on her fur so we think she’s just been chained up all her life.

Poor girl, but we are happy she is gaining confidence on a daily rate. Lucia is not cat tested yet. We really want a loving home for this girlie with another friendly dog and children over 12 years.

Very friendly with people and dogs. gentle nature, and is obedient, enjoys learning new things and a laid back.

name: Oliver
description:
Oliver is a 0 month old male Mastin located in Weymouth.

Gorgeous cuddly puppy Oliver is a beautiful-looking Spanish Mastin boy, with a lush, cream coat and darker face.

He has recently been admitted to his foster home and he is proving to be very calm, friendly and affectionate and, as you can see in the videos, he gets on well with his new kennel mates.

He is learning fast how good it is to have human company, after he was abandoned for so long as a puppy on his own.

At the moment he stands at medium height and is approximately 10 months old. He weighs 20kg and he needs to put some weight on, which is looking very good now as he fills out. He is healthy and has a confident personality.

It’s early days in his foster home and as we get more information we can update his page.

Oliver is going to be a big boy once fully grown, and he is large now and playful, so for that reason we need to look for a home with other young dogs (or no dogs) and older children over 12 years old. He hasn’t been tested for cats

Calm and friendly with people and dogs. Still learning to walk on the lead but improving daily. So much potential!

name: Lawrence
description:
Lawrence is a 6 month old male Galgo cross Podenco, super-friendly youngster, with a trusting and very nice nature considering he was abandoned to fend for himself on a dried up piece of land all on his own.

We have no idea what happened to his mum or why someone would just want to throw him away.

This very attractive, friendly six month old pup is a possible Galgo cross with a Podenco, which accounts for his attractive markings, with a beautiful high stepping gait super social and positive, loves the whole world.

We are looking for a family with or without another friendly dog for Lawrence to play with and children no younger than 8 yrs. Would suit an active family. Lawrence hasnt been tested for cats yet.

Loves to socialise, gets on very well with all dogs, loves `people, has a happy, friendly manner about him, affectionate with children, healthy condition.

name: Levi
description:
This little, cheeky chappie is Levi: 9 month old male Podenco Cross, a handsome and very friendly cross breed youngster, with a short, tan and white coat and attractive facial markings and a lovely social demeanour.

Just a little dot and he’s a bit of a whirlwind! But what a lovely little boy he is, very happy, friendly and confident little fella. Levi is only young, about 9 months old and about 12kg so just a smaller puppy boy.

Levi recently came into the rescue from a local vet found abandoned along with Raven, he’s very used to people so we think he has previously lived with a family.

Levi has recently been neutered, got his passport and vaccinations and clear blood tests so he’s ready to travel for the right family.

Levi would make a wonderful companion for a young family and equally he would do very well with any outdoor activities.We are looking for a home with or without another dog and children over 8 years old. Levi hasn’t been tested for cats yet

He is very clean in his pen, very loving and affectionate, cheeky and loves his kennel mates and playing.

name: Marly
description:
This lovely, gentle, large lad is Marley- a 3 year old, male Spanish Mastin. He has a beautiful, brown, textured thick coat, with unusual facial markings.

This handsome boy came to our attention because he is being left in a tiny apartment and a tinier balcony for 23 hours per day!

Marly is a very special and well-loved dog since puppyhood that, due to family circumstances, needs a new home.

He is beautifully trained, used to living inside, and a striking looking dog with a beautiful coat, affectionate with people and social with other dogs.

Due to Marley’s size, we think he is better homed with another female or as an only dog. He is used to the lead he will thrive in a rural environment, maybe a farm, small holding or large gardens, and a family used to walking or other outside activities.

He ignores cats and can live with children over 8 years.

He is very clean in his home, very loving and affectionate, and a nice social demeanor. Used to living with a family.

name: Sophie
description:
Sophie is a beautiful Portuguese Podengo girl, with a long, rough coat in light tan and white. Poor girl is just 4 years old, and has spent a lot of her life living on the streets and giving birth.

Sophie is a very sweet natured and calm girl, but also a little shy (she takes time to blossom and get to trust you, but once she does she’s a super sweet natured and affectionate girl).

Sophie loves her doggy pals, is good on the lead and a clean girl in her pen. She’s learning that people are kind and now enjoys the love and affection she’s shown but needs someone with time and patience to let her blossom.

Sophie is spayed, up to date with vaccinations and had clear blood tests, and tested negative for Brucella.

We are looking for a family with another friendly dog for Sophie to play with and learn from and older calm children no younger than 11yrs to suit her level of confidence. Sophie is ok with cats.

Sophie mixes well with other dogs, not bothered by cats, very calm and relaxed girl, walks well on her lead, needs someone to give her the time and patience to blossom

name: Nancy
description:
Nancy, pointer, 5.5 years old, medium/large sized girl.

Nancy, our sweet 5.5 year old pointer girl, is ready to find her forever home

Judging by Nancy’s breed and appearance, it is quite likely that she belonged to a hunter, bred for puppies, then dumped once she got too ‘old’.

She is the most gentle girl that gets on with everyone—dogs, people, children. She has a kind soul that doesn’t deserve the life she has led so far. Now it’s our chance to turn that around and make sure the rest of her life is worth living.

Since arriving at the shelter she has been loving and friendly, although, of course, cautious at first. She walks really well on the leash and does not pull.

We don’t think she will need an overly active home but will for sure enjoy her walks. Overall she is a well rounded girl and has shown everyone just how lovely she is and how deserving of a loving home she is.

Unfortunately for Nancy, she has leishmania. We are really hoping this doesn’t mean she is overlooked. Please don’t let this disease define her.

It is easily managed with cheap tablets, doesn’t affect how long she will live, doesn’t affect insurance premiums, and cannot be transmitted to other pets or humans.

Many dogs live long and happy lives with leishmania. Nancy is otherwise a healthy girl. We just hope someone sees how wonderful she is regardless of leishmania.

Nancy is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport. She will arrive with 6 months supply of leishmania treatment. She is fully vaccinated and spayed.

name: Kabo
description:
Kabo was brought into the shelter as a stray and has been your typical pointer since the day he arrived.

Super people oriented, very loving and cuddly, likely to be a velcro dog in typical pointer fashion!

Overall, Kabo has a lovely friendly nature and will be a wonderful companion for anyone lucky enough to adopt him.

He is a gentle boy so could live with children. He also walks well on a leash. He shares his space with both male and female dogs with no issues.

Kabo is not good with cats due to his prey drive, so a home with no small furries is a must.

We expect he will have medium-high energy levels once in a home and will need decent physical and mental stimulation.

Kabo is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and has been tested for infectious diseases.

name: Valentina
description:
Valentina is a 1 year old female Podenco cross Alsation.

Currently in a foster home in Suffolk, UK.

Some dogs leave a mark on your heart from the moment you hear their story.

On a cold winter day, Valentina was found lying beside her brother’s lifeless body. She had stayed with him, waiting for help to arrive, but sadly help came too late for her brother. Valentina, however, was given a second chance—and what an incredible girl she has become.

Now around one year old, Valentina is living in a foster home in Ipswich, where she has shown just how loving and devoted she can be.

She formed a beautiful bond with her foster mum remarkably quickly and has proven that beneath her cautious exterior is a dog with so much love to give.

Valentina is a sensitive soul who is still learning that the world can be a safe place. She thrives when given kindness, patience, and encouragement, and she needs a family who will allow her to build confidence at her own pace.

There is no rush with Valentina—she just needs people willing to meet her where she is and celebrate every small victory along the way.

She can be nervous around men, though she has never shown any aggression.

Her fear simply means she needs understanding and gentle guidance from people willing to earn her trust. For this reason, she may be happiest in a female-only household or with a family that understands fearful dogs and is committed to helping her continue her journey.

Valentina gets along great with other dogs with proper introductions. She also finds being left alone difficult. However, thanks to the dedication of her foster mum, she has already made remarkable progress and continues to improve.

She is a clever girl who enjoys learning and benefits greatly from mental stimulation, enrichment activities, and positive reinforcement training that keeps both her mind and her confidence growing.

What makes Valentina so special is watching her blossom. Every time she chooses to trust, every time she tries something new, every time her tail wags a little more freely, you can see the wonderful dog she is becoming.

Valentina is looking for a patient, loving home that will give her the security, understanding, and guidance she needs to continue shining. In return, you’ll gain the privilege of watching an extraordinary dog discover just how loved she truly is.

– ?Around 1 year old– Fostered in Suffolk– Loving and affectionate once she trusts– ?Intelligent and eager to learn– ?Making excellent progress with confidence building– ?Looking for a patient and understanding family

Are you the special person Valentina has been waiting for?

Because somewhere out there is the family who will look at this gentle girl and see not her fears, but her incredible potential. And when that happens, Valentina’s happiest chapter will finally begin.

name: Jessica
description:
Jessica, pointer cross, 4.5 years old, medium/large sized girl.

Jessica is a beautiful 4.5-year-old girl who came to us as a stray from Cyprus, and she’s been winning hearts ever since.

Despite her uncertain start, she has a gentle, trusting nature and a warm, affectionate personality that shines through in everything she does.

She’s a large dog with a balanced, medium energy level—she enjoys her daily walks and exploring the world around her, but she’s just as happy to settle down and relax with her people.

Jessica has a calm and easygoing temperament, which makes her a lovely companion both indoors and out.

Jessica is wonderful with children, showing patience and kindness, and she gets along well with other dogs, happily socialising and sharing her space.

Her friendly and adaptable nature means she could fit into a variety of home environments, whether as part of a busy family or a quieter household.

After her journey, Jessica is ready for a fresh start with a loving family who can offer her stability, care, and plenty of affection. In return, she promises to be a loyal, loving companion who will bring warmth and joy to her forever home.

Jessica is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and be tested for infectious diseases. She is fully vaccinated and spayed.

name: Dahlia
description:
I’m a beautiful two-year-old Pointer cross with a joyful spirit, and a heart full of love. If you’re looking for a dog who wants to be involved in everything you do, I might just be your perfect match!

I’m an active, intelligent girl who loves being around people. Whether it’s heading out for an adventure, exploring new places, joining you on a walk, or simply spending time with my family, I’m happiest when I’m included.

I thrive on companionship and enjoy building strong bonds with my humans.

I’m also a very clever girl who learns quickly and genuinely enjoys training. I love having a job to do, learning new skills, and using my brain as well as my energy.

With the right guidance and continued training, I’ll make an incredibly rewarding companion.

Because I’m young, enthusiastic, and full of zest for life, I’m looking for an active family who can provide plenty of exercise, enrichment, and opportunities to be part of everyday life.

In return, you’ll get a loyal best friend who will fill your home with love, fun, and laughter.

Due to my size and enthusiasm, I’m looking for a home with children aged 12 and over. I’ll also need a secure garden with 6-foot fencing where I can safely enjoy some outdoor time and stretch my long legs.

-2 years old– Affectionate and people-oriented– Intelligent and eager to learn– Active and adventurous– Loves companionship and attention– Looking for an active family– Secure garden with 6ft fencing required

If you’re searching for a loving, clever, and fun companion who is ready to share life’s adventures with you, Dahlia is waiting to meet you.

name: Smokey
description:
I’m a nearly 3-year-old Pointer cross with a handsome black and white coat, a permanent waggy tail, and a personality that can only be described as one thing: lovable goofball.

I’m a confident, happy boy who approaches life with enthusiasm and a sense of fun. Whether I’m out exploring, playing games, learning something new, or simply making my people laugh with my silly antics, I love being involved in everything that’s going on.

I’m incredibly affectionate and thrive on human company. I love spending time with my people and am never happier than when I’m included in family life.

Behind my playful, clownish side is a loyal dog who forms strong bonds and loves nothing more than being close to those he cares about.

As an active and intelligent boy, I’m looking for a family who can provide plenty of exercise, adventure, and mental stimulation.

I enjoy learning and would love adopters who are keen to continue my training and help me become the very best version of myself.

Because of my size and enthusiasm, I’m looking for a home with children aged 12 and over. I’ll also need a secure garden with 6-foot fencing where I can safely run, play, and enjoy life to the fullest.

If you’re looking for a confident, affectionate companion who will keep you laughing, join you on every adventure, and shower you with love, Smokey might just be the perfect addition to your family.

-Nearly 3 years old– Friendly and confident– Affectionate and people-oriented– Intelligent and eager to learn– Active and adventurous– Full of character and fun– Secure garden with 6ft fencing required

Smokey is the kind of dog who turns ordinary days into adventures and quickly becomes the heart of the home.

name: Peter
description:
Peter, 7 months old, pointer cross, medium-large boy.

Our boy Peter has been in the shelter since he was just 4 months old. He is super loving and friendly and adores people and other dogs.

He shares a yard with both male and female dogs of various sizes without issues. Equally, with children, he is keen to approach them, play, and lap up some attention – just like most puppies.

Peter is just a pup so will of course need some ongoing training, but he is already used to walking on the leash. He takes treats gently and is eager to please so we think he will be a joy to train.

Although he is a puppy, he has quite a calming energy. He will still require an active home dedicated to showing him the way in life.

Peter would be best suited to live with another doggy friend.

Overall, Peter is a joy to be around and will make the most wonderful companion for anyone lucky enough to adopt him.

Peter can be adopted in Cyprus or in the UK. He is ready to fly. He is vaccinated and has had a full health check and blood tests for infectious diseases.

name: Captain
description:
Captain is a 4.5 year old, medium-sized, male, lab cross who was abandoned in Cyprus by his owner 9 months ago. We will never know his full story—maybe his family moved away, or maybe they just decided they no longer wanted him.

Whatever the reason, Captain was left behind: alone, confused, and heartbroken. The fact that this boy is so loving and affectionate towards humans is a testament to him.

Perhaps it’s because he knows exactly what he has lost and he longs to find that again. He adores being around humans and is just such a happy boy. He doesn’t deserve to be in a kennel.

Captain has shown to be selective with other dogs so needs to be the only dog. He can be fostered, fostered with a view to adopt, or simply adopted.

Everyone involved in Captain’s plight is desperate to see him happy in a home. He is one of those dogs that it is quite heartbreaking to see him stuck in a kennel for close to 24 hours a day.

Captain will of course need patience and time to settle into a home, as with any rescue dog. We think that he may be house trained, given his past, and he also walks well on the leash.

Overall, we have no doubt this boy will be the best companion and anyone who is lucky enough to have him in their lives will just adore him.

Knowing what he has lost, Captain will be one of those dogs that is eternally grateful and will give back any love you give 10-fold.

Captain is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and be tested for infectious diseases. He is fully vaccinated and castrated.

name: Rocky
description:
Rocky is a 2 year old male Akita and is looking for his new forever home.

What can we say about Rocky? Isn’t he just gorgeous! He is also a bit of a doofus. Rocky is only a youngster at 2 years of age and hasn’t had much training in his short life. This has meant that he’s ended up like a giant puppy.

Rocky is very strong on the lead, especially around other dogs, bobbing and weaving left and right. Once he has calmed down, he does walk better, but a new owner will need to be prepared to spend time teaching Rocky how to walk nicely so that everyone has an enjoyable walk.

Rocky is only just learning his basic commands like sit. He also gets super excited when he sees his lead and knows he’s going out for a walk.

He likes to jump up to say hello and express his gratitude for getting attention. This is something that will be worked on in our care and needs continued training in a new home.

This lad really does not know his size and will happily walk into you without even flinching; he also came to us as a stray with no history, so we are looking for a home without any children or with children over the age of 12 years who are used to being around large breeds.

We are ideally looking for a home where he can be the only dog in his home. We feel at this stage he will need all of his adopters’ attention whilst he learns his basics.

We cannot place Rocky in a home where there are cats. With the correct training, Rocky is going to make some lucky adopter a fantastic companion; he is affectionate and really enjoys the company of people and making new friends.

name: Harper
description:
Harper is a 3 year old female Chocolate Labrador Retriever currently living in Spain and looking for her forever home due to her current owner’s ill health.

She currently lives with three cats but no children, so a home with older children would be best for her.

Harper is very boisterous and would be better suited to live with a non-dominant male dog or as the only dog in the home.

Harper was born in Spain and can travel wherever her wonderful forever home may be.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, has an EU passport, and has a clean bill of health.

Harper is submissive and cautious around other dogs and needs an experienced home where introductions to other dogs are carefully managed.

name: Kane
description:
Welcome the handsome and friendly gentleman, Kane. Kane is a 6 year old male Black Labrador Retriever with a medium build, weighing around 20 kilograms.

Kane has been in the shelter for over a year now. His best friend, Kahu, was finally adopted last month and now Kane is left behind. They had been together for the past year so now, more than ever, Kane needs to find his happy ever after.

Kane is a good, well-rounded boy and can already respond to basic commands. He is good with dogs of all shapes and sizes and relishes the opportunity for attention and a way to burn off energy.

He is super cuddly and will be a wonderful sofa dog, but will also require decent walks and new adventures.

Kane will need ongoing basic training and some patience to help him settle into home life. He is your typical Labrador Retriever – super friendly with everyone he meets, excitable, and food-oriented.

This lovely boy will suit most home settings – all he asks for is affection, nice walks, a roof over his head, and regular meals.

We have no doubt that he will be the most wonderful companion.

Kane is located in Cyprus and, if adopted in the UK, will travel with a passport and be tested for infectious diseases. He is fully vaccinated and castrated.

name: Ntina
description:
Ntina is a 3.5 year old female Kangal Shepherd Dog. She would prefer to be the only dog in the home and can live with children over the age of 12. She is currently located in Cyprus.

Kangal Shepherd Dogs often find themselves in shelters, abandoned due to their size. We made a promise to help find them all loving homes. Here are two Kangal Shepherd Dogs who ended up in the same shelter.

Next up is Ntina. She adores people, cuddles, and attention. She is slightly bigger than Keith, weighing approximately 50 kilograms. Ntina is easy to get along with and is much loved by the shelter staff and volunteers.

She was found as a stray, and it is hard to understand how anyone could abandon a dog and leave her to fend for herself, especially a dog of her size and with her thick coat.

Temperatures of 40 degrees on the streets of Cyprus in summer could not have been easy for her.

Ntina is friendly and placid with people and children, but due to her size she will need an experienced handler, and any children in the home must be over 12 years old. She needs a home where she can enjoy plenty of cuddles as well as long walks.

Ntina needs to be the only dog, as she can be selective around other dogs. Given her temperament, she would likely be happiest as the only dog in the home.

name: Batu
description:
Batu is a 3.5-year-old male Cross-Breed. Weighing 30kg and classed as a large dog, Batu currently lives in a shelter in Cyprus after being heartbreakingly surrendered by his previous owner.

Once living in an apartment, he’s now learning how to trust again in the noisy, unpredictable environment of a municipal shelter.

Though understandably wary at first, Batu has a heart of gold and a gentle nature that shines through once he starts to feel safe. He’s calm during vet visits, enjoys car journeys, and shows polite behaviour even when surrounded by barking, stressed-out dogs.

His composed reaction to chaotic situations is impressive and says a lot about his potential in a stable, loving home.

Batu can live with other dogs, particularly those of a similar size, or thrive as an only pet. In the shelter, he’s always curious and keen to say hello to the others, which shows his social side.

He’s already house trained from his previous home, and possibly has some basic training under his belt. Still, like all rescue dogs, he’ll benefit from ongoing support, routine, and positive reinforcement.

He would be happiest in a peaceful home that offers regular walks, space to rest, and most importantly, consistent affection. Batu deserves a second chance—not just at life, but at experiencing the kind of unconditional love and loyalty he’s more than ready to return.

name: Lacey
description:
